label: heart-s5-c2

analysis.note: The ischaemia gate 204 fans out to the output, to the BP gate 290 and to the damping node 1416, each read out directly into the logit; 1611 (LVH without exercise angina) and 3884 (high fasting sugar) are independent indicators. 'Readout only' removes a node's direct edge to the output and leaves downstream nodes unchanged; 'node with downstream' replaces the node's activation (zero or train mean) and propagates. Linear replacement = the node's ReLU replaced by the least-squares affine fit of its activation on its own inputs, propagated. Removing the ischaemia gate with its downstream effects takes the model just below the linear-core level (0.932 vs 0.933); all hidden readouts together add +0.006 train AUC. Treating every ReLU as identity drops AUC to 0.917, so the gating (not the extra terms) is what the hidden nodes contribute.

resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. The ischaemia gate 204 feeds two downstream gates (290, 1416) as well as the output; the two links were intercepted with identity nodes (identity_290, identity_1416) so that each hidden node is its own leaf, and the root composes all five. Counter-directional signs reported, not explained: restecg:0 (normal ECG) raises the ischaemia score (its direct edge is -0.16), trestbps enters the risk-raising BP gate negatively (low resting BP opens it), thal:6 (fixed defect) has a direct -0.41 edge (partly offset by +0.07/SD through 1416), fbs:0 +0.26 directly so high fasting sugar lowers the logit overall despite the +0.07 indicator. thal:4 shuts the ischaemia gate but has only 2 training patients. The damping node 1416 and the fasting-sugar node 3884 are effectively linear (affine R2 0.99 and 1.0); the LVH indicator and fasting-sugar indicator barely affect ranking (readout ablation <= -0.0003 AUC).
tool_bugs: get_input_distribution does not accept sample_fraction (called with max_samples only; all 242 rows used). get_viz_summary requires viz_type (sensitivity used). compute_shap (kernel, all 242 train rows) gives the five unconnected inputs mean |SHAP| about 0.001 instead of exactly 0 (sampling noise). get_model_state's 'operations' key is absent, so op counts come from check_explanation.py. The agent sandbox refused compound shell commands, so tools were called through a small Python subprocess wrapper in scratch (same xn.py).
summary: Mostly logistic regression: 17 direct edges (logit SD 3.19; train AUC 0.933 alone) plus a small ischaemia block (logit SD 0.57 for all hidden readouts) to 0.939. An ischaemia gate ReLU(0.39 + 2.54 oldpeak + 0.99 restecg:0 - 0.88 thal:4) opens above an ST-depression threshold that is lower with a normal resting ECG and raises risk directly and through a gate that passes the score on minus a resting-blood-pressure offset (more risk when BP is low); a near-linear node takes back part of the ischaemia score and adds a fixed-defect term. Two small indicators add risk for LVH without exercise angina and (negligibly) for high fasting sugar. Same ischaemia-gate -> resting-BP-gate core as the 10-seed heart-s5 record (key 9330) and the sibling lead heart-s5-c1, but without their age gate.
